Name: More Skin Tone Options 2.0
Author: sneakyham
Description:
I just wanted to add more skin tones to my game to make different farmers, but was having a hard time finding a mod that didn't make the player look flat due to the lack of contrast/high saturation that Stardew has, so I tried to make my own that maintained the aesthetic while giving a couple more options. It's a little difficult since the max amount of total tones you can make is 24, but hopefully someone else will like them.

There are:
- 6 Neutral Tones
- 6 Pink Tones
- 5 Gold Tones
- 5 Copper Tones
- 2 Ash Tones

[size=3][color=#00ffff]If you're having issues with all of your farmers' skin tones getting shifted around and you don't want to have to pay the wizard or wait until you unlock his basement the smapi command is "debug cmenu" to enter the character creation menu.[/color]
[/size]
Not compatible with any other mod that also replaces the skin tones unfortunately. If I knew how to just add them on as options I would do more shades. But if anyone does know how to do that I'd be happy to learn how.

[size=5][u]UPDATE:[/u][/size]
[u]
[s]Sep 25, 2023[/s] - [/u] Currently working on adding more skin tone options based on [url=https://x.com/puppsicle/status/1490882152354893828?s=20]Puppsicle's Skin Tone Palettes[/url] along with adding a config option to allow you to swap between more colors!﻿ Will probably work on adding more rainbow-like colors after that. [color=#00ff00](All Complete :D)[/color]

There are now 5 more palettes along with the original colors with a config option that allows you to easily switch between them using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
- Vanilla (Base Game Skins)
- Modded (version 1.0 options)
- Neutral Tones
- Warm Tones
- Cool Tones
- Prismatic Tones
- Pastel Tones

[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]Other skin tone mods I've discovered since making this!
[/size][/color]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7764?tab=description]Ethnic Skin Tones[/url] by psychemoss
-﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15089?tab=description]New Skin Tones[/url] by ﻿prettypinktardis and Runzu
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] by PeacefulEnd also now allows the ability to change skin tones using HSL sliders with the new "body" options (Currently only for 1.6)
